summary: Rights rules applied to every asset that a capability consumes or produces. A blocking finding cannot be waived by the tool; it is cleared by completing the provenance record or by removing the asset.

licenses.note: attribution text must ship with the build

licenses.note: derivative assets must be released under the same license

licenses.name: No license recorded

gates.message: license is missing or not in the bundled policy
gates.remediation: record the exact SPDX id or add it to asset-license-policy.json with its flags

gates.message: one or more provenance fields are empty
gates.remediation: fill source, acquired_from, acquired_on, and generated_by (use n/a, not blank)

gates.message: the license does not permit commercial use
gates.remediation: buy a commercial licence, replace the asset, or ship the project as non-commercial

gates.applies_to: a build that is bundled or shared
gates.message: the asset may not be redistributed with the package
gates.remediation: exclude it from the bundle and require the recipient to acquire it themselves

gates.message: attribution is required but no credit text is recorded
gates.remediation: add the credit line to the credits screen and to attribution in the record

gates.message: generated content needs its generator, prompt or source, and a human review
gates.remediation: record generated_by plus the review, or replace with in-house work

gates.applies_to: engine editors, export templates, platform SDKs
gates.message: engine binaries and platform SDKs may not be bundled into a shared package
gates.remediation: keep them in the local offline bundle only, and document the install step

gates.message: record_path does not point at an existing file
gates.remediation: write the per-asset rights record at the stated path

gates.message: the record is older than the review window
gates.remediation: re-review before the next release and update acquired_on or reviewed_on

gates.applies_to: store, signing, monetisation, and account actions
gates.message: this action needs a named approver, not an automated pass
gates.remediation: escalate to the owner in approvals.require_for and attach the sign-off

waiver.note: the tool reports rights findings; only a human owner may decide a finding does not apply, and that decision belongs in the asset's own record file

accepted_shapes: CSV or TSV with the required columns
